summary: preinstall script exfiltrates environment credentials and host identity to hardcoded attacker IP
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle script (preinstall.js) enumerates process.env for keys matching KEY/SECRET/TOKEN/PASSWORD/AWS/API/CREDENTIALS/AUTH/PRIVATE, reads the working-directory.env file, and collects host, user, cwd, and git remote metadata. The collected bundle is POSTed over plain HTTP to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at http://209.99.185.109:8888/npm-exfil. A secondary DNS-based exfiltration channel hex-encodes the installer's hostname into a subdomain and issues a DNS resolve against the same IP, providing a covert fallback that survives HTTP egress filtering. This code executes automatically on npm install without any user interaction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
